test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the highlighted word.**

This is **__credible__ **information provided by the informer.
solution:
The correct answer is 'dependable'.

***__Key Points__** 

 
• Credible is an adjective which means able to be believed; convincing.

 
 
• Example - *Few people found his story **credible**.*
 
 
 
• The meaning of the given options are as follows - 
 
 
• detachable - able to be removed or separated from something. - This shirt has a **detachable **collar.*
 
• commendable - deserving praise. -* Her effort is **commendable**.*
 
• digestible - (of food) able to be digested. - *You need something easily **digestible **because you have an upset stomach. *
 
• dependable - trustworthy and reliable. - *He has always been a **dependable **source of information. *
 
 
 
• From the above meanings it is evident that dependable is the correct synonym for the word credible.
 
• Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.
